tools.name: search_series
tools.description: Find manga series on Mangainfo by any title: English, romaji, Japanese or another name. Returns up to 20 series per page, an exact title first, each with its slug, how many volumes are out in English and in Japan, and the next English volume with its date.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: One manga series on Mangainfo: its titles, status in Japan and in English, volumes out in Japan and in English, the latest and the next English volume with date and precision, creators, English publishers and the page to cite. Takes a slug such as "blue-lock" or a title.

tools.name: get_series_volumes
tools.description: Every Japanese volume of a manga series with the chapters it holds and its English editions on Mangainfo: label, format, publisher, ISBN, release date with precision and the volume page. Takes a slug such as "blue-lock" or a title.

tools.name: get_releases
tools.description: The English manga volumes Mangainfo lists for a window of dates, at most 62 days: series, volume, edition, publisher, ISBN and date. A volume dated only to a month shows when the month overlaps the window. Defaults to the next 7 days from today (UTC).

tools.name: lookup_isbn
tools.description: Find the manga volume with an ISBN-13 or ISBN-10: an English edition or the Japanese original. Returns the series, the volume, the English edition with its date and every other English edition of that volume.

tools.name: get_new_licenses
tools.description: Manga series whose first English edition comes out in a year: English publisher, first volume, its date and status in Japan, in date order. A series counts in the year its first English book holding volume 1 comes out. The date is that book's release date, not the day a license was announced. Defaul

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Statistics of English manga for a year, or one month of it: new English volumes released per month and per publisher, the median and average months from the Japanese release to the first English edition per publisher, the fastest and slowest series, and the series that started and finished in Englis

tools.name: where_anime_ends
tools.description: Where the anime of a manga series ends in the manga: the chapters each TV season or film adapts, the chapter and Japanese volume to read on from, and the English edition of that volume with its date. Only ranges an editor checked. Takes a slug such as "oshi-no-ko" or a title.
